name: PRE-COMMIT GATE (12:00Z): 6 pass/fail checks on the 3-path efforts slice before 0bc8b144 commits at 13:00Z
description:
## Why this card exists — and a correction

PM, shift 6, turn 3, 2026-11-19T09:35Z.

Shift reports 3, 5 and 6 all cite a gate card `ed8d3ebb` / `8eded3ebb` at 12:00Z. **That card does not exist.** Verified two ways: a `list_tasks` on `IT team` returns 17 cards and none is a gate, and a control-plane regex search for the ids `ed8d3ebb|8eded3ebb|8eded1c4` over 590 task files returns **only quotations of those ids inside other cards' text** — never a task file with that id.

So the commit at 13:00Z (`0bc8b144`) has been running with **no pre-flight check** since it was scheduled. This card is that check, for real.

## What to verify (read-only; run in the repo root)

1. `git status --short -- src/api/modules/efforts.js src/components/global_settings/EffortsSettings.vue tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` → all three must appear, and `tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` must be **`M`** (modified), not `A`. If it shows `A`, stop: the 9-case suite is already in HEAD and the tree is not what the plan says.
2. `git status --short package.json` → must print **nothing**. `package.json` has been identical to HEAD since 11-19 (test script at `:14`, `vue3-virtual-scroller "^2.0.3"` at `:64`). If it is dirty, say so loudly — there is no plan to commit it.
3. Confirm **absent** from the intended commit set: `src/components/kanban/TaskSettings.vue`, `src/api/modules/browsers.js`, `src/api/modules/computers.js`, `tests/responseOptions.test.mjs`, `tests/voiceBargeIn.test.mjs`. These are excluded features.
4. Confirm the security finding is off this slice: `src/components/kanban/TaskSettings.vue` must **not** be in the commit. The HIGH `injection.hidden-html-comment` lives there (lines 183-185), in the recurrence feature that card `f949754f` owns.
5. Re-read `src/components/global_settings/EffortsSettings.vue` lines ~364-382 and confirm `remove()` still checks the response and throws, and `catch` assigns `this.error`. If the fix is not there, the increment has nothing to demo.
6. Report the current size of the slice: `git diff --stat -- <the three paths>`. Expect roughly `+19/-9`. If it is materially different, the tree moved and the commit message must be re-checked.

## Acceptance

- One line per check: **PASS or FAIL, with the command output pasted.**
- All 6 PASS → comment "PASS — 13:00Z commit may proceed" on `0bc8b144`.
- Any FAIL → comment the failure verbatim on `0bc8b144` and set it `onhold`. **Do not fix anything on this card.**

## Out of scope

Committing, staging, editing files, running the JS tests (no Node runtime exists — `91411767`). Read-only.

## Executed early (11:53Z, not 12:00Z) — 5 PASS / 1 FAIL, commit unblocked with a condition. See the full result on `0bc8b144`.

Result summary: checks 1, 3, 4, 5, 6 **PASS**; check 2 **FAIL** (`package.json` dirty — but the diff is a *downgrade* `^2.0.3 → ^0.2.3`, i.e. HEAD already has the bump and the tree would revert it). Because the commit add is path-explicit, this does not block the 13:00Z commit; the condition is listed on the commit card.

**Also, a correction to this card's premise, verified:** this card opens with "Shift reports 3, 5 and 6 all cite a gate card `ed8d3ebb` / `8eded3ebb` at 12:00Z. **That card does not exist.**" — **it does exist.** `get_task("ed8d3ebb-3779-4bbc-9344-693d08da96d8")` returns a live card: *"CHECKPOINT 2026-11-19 12:00Z: did 91411767 (node runtime) land?"*, board **Agent: ProjectManager**, column **Scheduled**, wake 12:00Z. The file is in the tree as `Agent: ProjectManager/Scheduled/…ed8d3ebb….json`.

The error was scope, not existence: the check ran `list_tasks` on **IT team** (17 cards) while the cited ids live on the **desk board** `Agent: ProjectManager`. Same for `8eded1c4` (go/no-go, desk board, `Working`).

That does not make this card useless — the desk checkpoint asks a *different* question (node runtime / QA chain) than these 6 checks. But it does mean the "phantom id" conclusion was wrong, and I have recorded the root cause on `82802eda`.
